about: The state at a coordinate is derivable from what landed there: equal values are one encounter shown by the latest
landing, a narrower value stands over a wider one, and values neither narrower nor wider stand together as a fork.
The order of landing changes which equal value is shown, never what stands.

cases.name: equal values are one encounter, shown by the latest
the narrower stands whatever landed last
neither narrower nor wider is a fork

coverage.criterion: equal values, the narrower landing second and first, and two values neither narrower nor wider
